WITH CustomerTotals AS (
  SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS CustomerTotal
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
), Shares AS (
  SELECT CustomerId,
         CustomerTotal,
         CustomerTotal * 1.0 / SUM(CustomerTotal) OVER () AS RevenueShare
  FROM CustomerTotals
), AboveAverage AS (
  SELECT CustomerTotal, RevenueShare
  FROM Shares
  WHERE RevenueShare > (SELECT AVG(RevenueShare) FROM Shares)
)
SELECT AVG(CustomerTotal) AS AverageAmountSpent,
       AVG(RevenueShare) AS AverageShare,
       AVG(RevenueShare - (SELECT AVG(RevenueShare) FROM Shares)) AS AverageShareAboveAverage
FROM AboveAverage;

assumptions.assumption: Customers with no invoices are excluded because their invoice total is undefined; shares and the average share are calculated across customers with invoices.
